name: lead-claude
description: Experimental (2026-11-18, F120 to F123; docs/24-lead.md): Claude Opus 5.5 medium leads, and works only where it decides. A trivial or small self-contained request goes to Claude Haiku 5.5 alone (no Opus turn). Otherwise, on a big repository Haiku first writes a report for the request; Opus plans from it (under about 700 words): the acceptance cases, the implied ones too, and per task a developer: grunt (Haiku low), worker (Haiku high), senior (Claude Sonnet 5.5 high) or itself. After the build, Haiku probes every case and Neuromesh re-runs each probe: all hold and the checks pass, accepted with no Opus turn; otherwise Opus reviews read-only from the evidence and adds follow-ups for whom it chooses, at most twice. No separate tester.
